# GET /api/v1/users/{username}/starred

List repos that the given user has starred

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-152`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| username | path | string | True |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — RepositoryList

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `[]` | Repository | Array of repository objects |

- **403** — Stars disabled by administrator
